Name: Grave Digger
Base Trait: Can dig dirt and bury bodies
Combat Ability: Cleave: hits every zombie in the swing arc
Bonus Abilities (Legendary): Execute: instantly kills zombies below 20% HP; Kills restore 5 stamina
How to Obtain: Quest 'Hallowed Ground': defeat The Groundskeeper boss at St. Agnes Cemetery
Unique Look: Rust-black cemetery spade with a wrought-iron cross welded to the shaft and rosary beads wrapped around the grip. The blade is always caked with grave dirt that never washes off.
Flavor Text: The groundskeeper of St. Agnes buried the first three hundred himself. When the dead stopped staying down, he stopped digging graves and started filling them.

Name: Kintsugi
Combat Ability: Crits cause Bleed: 10 dmg/s for 4 s
Bonus Abilities (Legendary): Every 5th kill heals 10 HP; Parry: 15% chance to negate an incoming melee hit
How to Obtain: Craft: Broken Katana Blade + Gold Bar x3 + Master Smith's Notes (Notes from quest 'The Last Forge')
Unique Look: Black-steel katana that was shattered and rejoined, with veins of gold running across the blade. Gold-wrapped hilt and a cracked porcelain guard.
Flavor Text: It snapped in half against the skull of the first Brute anyone ever fought. A dead jeweler's gold put it back together. Broken things, mended well, are strongest at the seams.

Name: Thunderclap
Combat Ability: Electrified: chains to 3 nearby zombies, 30% stun chance
Bonus Abilities (Legendary): Shockwave: heavy attacks deal 50% damage in a 2-tile radius; Reveals zombies within 10 tiles when charged
How to Obtain: Boss drop: The Juggernaut at Riverside Power Station
Unique Look: Sledgehammer with a transformer coil bolted around the head, blue arcs crawling over copper wire, and a cracked voltage gauge on the handle.
Flavor Text: Lineman Dale Okafor kept the Riverside substation running for 41 days after the grid failed. They found his hammer next to the transformer. They never found Dale. It still hums when the dead are near.

Name: Redline
Base Trait: Continuous damage while held; burns fuel
Combat Ability: Enflamed chain: Burn 8 dmg/s for 4 s
Bonus Abilities (Legendary): Bleed on every hit; Each kill heals 2 HP;' +10% damage reduction while revving
How to Obtain: Achievement 'Heavy Metal': kill 1,000 zombies with any chainsaw, then rebuild it at Gus's Scrapyard
Unique Look: Hot-rod red chainsaw with a chrome exhaust stack, flame decals, and a chain of sharpened license-plate teeth. Spits fire when revved.
Flavor Text: Built in a scrapyard by a motorcycle mechanic who refused to let the noise make him hide. His reasoning: they are coming anyway, so they might as well come to the music.

Unique Look: Recurve bow of pale ash wood carved with moon phases, limbs wrapped in owl feathers, and a bowstring that glows faint silver at night.
Flavor Text: Strung by a park ranger who survived the first winter alone in the backcountry. For six months, nobody heard a thing from her. That was the point.

Name: Iron Psalm
Combat Ability: Additional projectiles: fires 3 bolts in a fan
Bonus Abilities (Legendary): Crits make the bolt explode (2-tile radius); Piercing: bolts pass through 2 zombies

Unique Look: Heavy crossbow of blackened iron and church-pew oak, scripture etched along the rail, and a small brass bell hanging from the stock.
Flavor Text: A pastor turned his bell tower into a sniper's nest and preached to the horde below, one verse per bolt. The congregation never got smaller. He never ran out of verses.

Name: The Twins
Combat Ability: Auto-return: axes fly back to your hand and are never lost
Bonus Abilities (Legendary): Bleed: 6 dmg/s for 4 s; Seeking: each axe locks onto a different zombie
How to Obtain: Quest chain 'Twin Oaks': find both halves of the Morrow sisters' journal
Unique Look: A matched pair of hatchets forged from a red farm gate. One has a sun stamped into the steel, the other a moon. Handles bound in faded blue and gold ribbon.
Flavor Text: Forged by twin sisters from the steel of their family's farm gate. They never once threw at the same zombie. They never once missed.

Name: Last Rites
Base Trait: Can fire both barrels at once
Combat Ability: Hallowed fire: pellets Burn 8 dmg/s for 4 s
Bonus Abilities (Legendary): Double tap: firing both barrels deals +50% damage and heavy knockback; 20% chance on kill to refund a shell;' +10% movement speed
How to Obtain: Boss drop: The Undertaker at Greenlawn Funeral Home
Unique Look: Double-barrel shotgun with silver-engraved lilies on the receiver, a coffin-wood stock studded with brass nails, and a black ribbon tied around the barrels.
Flavor Text: Greenlawn's undertaker buried this town's dead for 30 years. When they started getting back up, he decided the job was not finished, only changed.

Name: Dead Man's Hand
Combat Ability: Ricochet: each bullet bounces to 1 nearby zombie
Bonus Abilities (Legendary): Every 6th shot is a guaranteed crit; Fan the Hammer: empty all 6 rounds in 1 s
How to Obtain: Quest 'The Last Sheriff': finish the Harlan County sheriff's list
Unique Look: Nickel-plated revolver with an ivory grip inlaid with black aces and eights, a sheriff's star pinned to the holster, and notches carved down the barrel.
Flavor Text: The last sheriff of Harlan County kept a list of all 412 residents. Every one he found, he gave peace. He made it to 411. The last name on the list was his own.

Name: Long Goodbye
Passive: Steady aim: no scope sway while crouched
Combat Ability: Piercing: passes through every zombie in its path
Bonus Abilities (Legendary): Headshots explode (2-tile radius);' +40% crit damage; Scope highlights special zombies through walls
How to Obtain: Quest 'Overpass': hold the Route 9 overpass for 10 waves until the last bus crosses
Unique Look: Desert-tan .50 cal with National Guard patches stitched onto the cheek rest, a cracked radio taped to the stock, and 19 tally marks scratched into the barrel.
Flavor Text: A National Guard marksman held the Route 9 overpass for 19 days so the last evacuation buses could cross the river. When the final bus cleared, he radioed one word: goodbye. Then he went back to work.

Name: Turncoat
Combat Ability: Corrosive rounds: 4 dmg/s for 5 s
Bonus Abilities (Legendary): Turn: 10% chance a hit zombie fights for you for 8 s; No movement penalty while held
How to Obtain: Final quest of the 'Clean Room' chain: escape Lab 6 at Halvorsen Biomedical
Unique Look: White and safety-orange lab-built LMG with a glass serum canister feeding glowing green rounds, biohazard stickers, and a barcode etched into the stock.
Flavor Text: Recovered from Lab 6 at Halvorsen Biomedical. The rounds are laced with a failed cure. It never saved anyone. It does make them turn on each other.
